thread:
Liam (Sales): Passing TwinPeak Finance to CS. Mid-market fintech, $120k ARR. Trial ends in ~4 weeks. Use case: document ingestion + private deployment for PII-sensitive prompts. Primary asks: SAML SSO + SCIM, VPC peering, CSV ingestion pipeline. They're worried about latency and token costs at scale.

Maya (CS): Thanks Liam — taking point for CS. Quick Q: Private from day one or staged? Who's twinpeak contact for infra? :call_me_hand:

Liam (Sales): They want Private (customer-managed VPC) due to legal. Will want Dedicated-grade perf inside their VPC. Contact: jordan.t@twinpeak.com. They use NetBridge (third-party infra). I uploaded a sample CSV to the secure share.

Maya (CS): Plan outline: 1) Kickoff & auth contacts 2) SSO/SCIM test 3) Network prep (peering + allowlist) 4) Ingest dry-run 5) Prod flip. I'll assign owners and timeline after kickoff.

Devon (Eng): I'll take ingestion work. Need sample (<500MB preferred), a schema, and to know whether PII columns are pre-encrypted. If not, we'll run our token-masking or anonymization stage. Also need to know if they require streaming responses.

Liam (Sales): Sample is in secure share. They said some PII fields may be hashed by their preprocessor but not guaranteed. They confirmed streaming for a subset of scoring calls.

Aria (Support): I'll draft the support runbook and escalation chain. Once we confirm net paths and IPs I'll create a private triage channel and onboard their ops. Who is owning KMS/HSM setup?

Maya (CS): I'll loop in Security for KMS. TwinPeak prefers AWS KMS CMKs (customer-managed). I'll collect their key policy and required IAM principals.

Devon (Eng): For the CSV mapping, please have them validate this sample mapping: 
```
columns: [timestamp, user_id, amount, description]
date_format: RFC3339
pii: [user_id, description]
```
We can insert a redaction/anonymization step if needed.

Liam (Sales): Also highlight renewal risk: they flagged per-token spend and latency SLAs. If CS/Eng produce a perf baseline and caching strategy, should ease concerns.

Maya (CS): Action list + owners:
- Kickoff meeting (owner: Maya) 1 - Schedule this week, invite Sales, TwinPeak ops, Eng, Support
- SSO/SCIM setup & test (owner: Maya; Security support)
- VPC peering & IP allowlist (owner: Liam for vendor comms; Eng to provide CIDRs)
- Ingestion dry-run (owner: Devon)
- KMS integration checklist (owner: Maya + Security)
- Perf/cost baseline and caching recommendations (owner: Devon + Maya)

Aria (Support): I'll prepare a target SLO doc for their latency expectations and a named on-call escalation list. Will spin up the private support channel after the kickoff.

OnboardBot: Meeting created: Thu 10:00 AM PT — calendar invites sent to participants.

Devon (Eng): One unresolved: streaming vs batch endpoints. If streaming, we need to validate NAT timeouts and load balancer idle timeouts on their VPC path. Please confirm flows.

Liam (Sales): I'll get the exact streaming flows and share in the kickoff.

Maya (CS): I'll run the kickoff, capture Jordan's SAML metadata (note: ACS URL will change after initial config), and post a 2-week onboarding timeline. Current renewal risk: medium until perf baseline and VPC peering validated. :white_check_mark:
